test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The 'Karmayoddha Granth' book was released by which of the following politician?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 'Karmayoddha Granth'** was released by** Amit Shah, the Union Home Minister of India.**
 
• **The Granth **narrates the **life of Narendra Modi, the Prime Minister of India, and his political journey**.
 
• It describes **PM Modi as a 'Karmayoddha' (a man with a determined resolution).**
 
• It outlines how his leadership has transformed India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Rahul Gandhi
 Member of the Indian National Congress and former president of the party.
 
 

 Nitin Gadkari
 Minister of Road Transport and Highways; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in the Government of India.
 
 

 Smriti Irani
 Minister of Women and Child Development and Textiles in the Government of India.
